functions.name: InitializeCleanupSequence
functions.comment:
Initialize cleanup sequence during DLL detach operation.

Algorithm:
1. Call FUN_1001f12e with parameters (0, 0, 1) to start cleanup sequence
2. Return immediately after cleanup initialization

Parameters:
None - Function takes no parameters

Returns:
void - No return value (cleanup initialization is fire-and-forget)

Special Cases:
Called only during DLL_PROCESS_DETACH when DAT_1003c940 cleanup flag is clear
Part of orderly shutdown sequence before main cleanup functions execute

Magic Numbers Reference:
0x0 - First parameter to FUN_1001f12e (cleanup mode indicator)
0x0 - Second parameter to FUN_1001f12e (flags/options)  
0x1 - Third parameter to FUN_1001f12e (initialization phase identifier)
